methods_mapped.a1b_result_fit: A1b CEGIS delta was 0.0, so the next swing adapts or retrieves dynamics at test time before planning through the engine.
methods_mapped.evidence: arXiv:2506.02918 trains internal state prediction for language agents; arXiv:2509.03956 composes world models at test time; arXiv:2507.15877 compares ARC execution-guided synthesis with test-time fine-tuning.
methods_mapped.experiment_graft: Collect cold-start transitions, fit or retrieve a compact dynamics adapter, then remeasure held-out transition accuracy before any planner reranking.
methods_mapped.fails_when: The adapter memorizes prefix frames, loses hidden state, or improves observed replay while held-out dynamics remain flat.
methods_mapped.method: Test-time world-model and dynamics adaptation loop
methods_mapped.sovereignty_note: The adapter can be selected or trained locally from game observations, preserving the air-gapped path.
methods_mapped.validation_gate: Promote only if held-out off-prefix transition accuracy improves on games disjoint from the adapter's observed-prefix fit.

methods_mapped.a1b_result_fit: A1b's null CEGIS result means the loop needs a stronger inducer measurement, not another repair pass from the same engine.
methods_mapped.evidence: arXiv:2605.05138 supplies the executable-world-model coding-agent reference; arXiv:2507.03160 evaluates small code models; arXiv:2203.13474 establishes open multi-turn code synthesis.
methods_mapped.experiment_graft: Run one Family-B reference lane and one local open-code lane against the same engine interface and held-out transition gate.
methods_mapped.fails_when: The reference lane still overfits observed prefixes, or no local open inducer can synthesize executable state updates.
methods_mapped.method: Family-B reference versus local open-code inducer A/B
methods_mapped.sovereignty_note: The cloud-strength lane is a ceiling measurement; the desired deployment lane remains local and open.
methods_mapped.validation_gate: The reference lane measures the capability ceiling; the local lane is promoted only if it beats the current Qwen3.5-9B-MTP inducer under the A1 held-out game set.

methods_mapped.a1b_result_fit: A1b failed to repair from generic counterexamples; decision-oriented targets ask the agent what transition facts it needs before acting.
methods_mapped.evidence: arXiv:2606.25421 replaces next-observation prediction with agent-authored dynamics targets; arXiv:2506.02918 shows state prediction can support language-agent tool planning.
methods_mapped.experiment_graft: For each failed held-out transition, generate a decision-need target such as hidden toggle state, object persistence, or action effect, then train or prompt the inducer against that target.
methods_mapped.fails_when: The generated targets mirror the model's misconception or require observations the game has not exposed.
methods_mapped.sovereignty_note: Target construction is derived from local traces and can feed either the local inducer or the reference lane.
methods_mapped.validation_gate: Count the method only when targeted transition facts raise held-out engine accuracy, not just when next-frame text improves.

methods_mapped.a1b_result_fit: A1b's flat delta leaves compounding one-step dynamics error as a candidate residual; prefix-level prediction attacks that error.
methods_mapped.evidence: arXiv:2606.26217 predicts latents for action prefixes instead of rolling one step at a time; arXiv:2506.02918 adds state prediction to agents; arXiv:2507.15877 keeps ARC execution guidance in scope.
methods_mapped.experiment_graft: Add an action-prefix probe over candidate sequences and compare its held-out transition predictions against the current one-step engine.
methods_mapped.fails_when: Prefix supervision hides wrong mechanics, or the latent state cannot be decoded into executable game-state checks.
methods_mapped.sovereignty_note: A small prefix adapter can run locally and can be swapped behind the same executable-engine interface.
methods_mapped.validation_gate: Promote only if long-horizon held-out transition accuracy improves without degrading one-step observed-prefix replay.
